title: Ukuthetha Kuye
intro: Kuvela umntu kwimbali engcwele, ephethe imimangaliso eyayichasene nomyalelo wendalo. Lo mphefumlo ufike ngomyalelo omnye kaThixo, wakhusela umzali kwizityholo ezinzulu, waza wemka kweli hlabathi ngaphambi kokuba amatyathanga asemhlabeni awabophe. Ibali liqala ebuntwaneni obuphantsi ukuya emazulwini aphezulu. Ngubani lo?
clues: Ndithunywe njengomqondiso nenceba evela kuAllah kuBantwana bakwaSirayeli.
Ukufika kwam kwakungafani nakuqala — ndazalwa ligama likaThixo elithi 'Yiba!' ngaphandle kotata wasemhlabeni.
Umzali wam wadibana nokuhletywa okuqatha, kodwa isityhilelo esingcwele sehla ukuze sivakalise ubumsulwa babo size siphakamise isikhundla sabo.
Njengosana olusandul’ ukuzalwa, ndabamangalisa abo babendingqongile ngokuthetha ngokucacileyo ukususela ebuntwaneni bam ukuze ndihlambulule igama lomzali wam.
Ngemvume ka-Allah, ndabumba ubomi ngodongwe olungaphiliyo, ndavula amehlo kwiimfama, ndaza ndaphilisa umntu oneqhenqa ngokumchukumisa kwam.
Ndanyuselwa ezulwini ngaphambi kokuba ingozi indichaphazele, kwaye ndiza kubuyela kweli hlabathi ngaphambi kokuba iXesha lokugqibela lifike.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Unyuselwe emazulwini, uya kubuya ngaphambi koMhla woMgwebo
Wakhokela abantwana bakwaSirayeli ukuba baphume eJiputa
Waba ngukumkani olawula iijin, abantu neentaka
Ndasinda kwisikhukula esikhulu kunye nabantu abathembekileyo

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
